[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
25th May, 2012]
No.FD(Reg-II)II-24/2010/771-1021,
dated 25-5-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Article 119 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the Governor of
Balochistan is pleased to make the following amendments in the Balochistan,
Government Delegation of Powers under the Financial Rules and Power of
Re-appropriation Rules, 2008, namely:--
In

not exceed 10%. In case it does exceed, fresh Administrative Approval will be

Note:--I: When there is unanimity, no reference to the
Provincial Development Working Party (PDWP) shall be necessary but in case of
difference of opinion, the scheme shall be referred to the Provincial
Development Working Party.
(a) These
powers shall be exercised only in respect of plans, schemes involving
expenditure of development nature. The PC-1 should not include provision for
staff and vehicles which should be got cleared from Finance Department prior to
placing the PC-1 for consideration and approval of competent forum.
(b) No
expenditure on a scheme shall be incurred unless it is referred in the ADP/PSDP
and there is a provision in the development budget of the year.
(c) The
schemes so approved and sanctioned shall be sent to the Planning and
Development and Finance Department simultaneously for their record.
(d) Where
any of the members is not present, the scheme should not be approved unless
that member has sent his comments in writing and these comments have been
considered by the Departmental Selection Committee.
(e) The
schemes sanctioned should be in line with the objectives of the
National/Provincial plans and there is no deviation from the principles and
polices laid down in the plans.
(f) The
schemes do not have economic or other repercussions beyond the province.
